scope: Reconcile the latest GTK2 evidence by state and separate installed behavior, private-engine prototypes, direct SR10.4/VUE observations, and human review.

normal.gtk2: Installed GTK2 normal stepper cells compare 0/225 to the retained SR10.4/VUE crops (R394/R496); the live VUE horizontal cells also compare 0/225 to its retained native crop (R469/R553).
normal.status: verified for normal-state geometry; the reported narrow horizontal cell is not reproduced

pressed_released.gtk2: Private native GTK2 previews change 53 pixels per arrow and restore exactly on release (R480/R642/R683).
pressed_released.sr104_vue: The lower vertical arrow has a partial live transition: 37 of 53 changed pixels are visible because the pointer occludes 16 (R434/R648); horizontal and upper held states lack direct cursor-clear VUE captures.
pressed_released.status: GTK2 interaction verified; historical comparison partial

hover.gtk2: GTK2 runtime paints the focused assets in private previews (R383/R387/R669).
hover.sr104_vue: No direct VUE hover capture identified.

whole_widget_insensitive.gtk2: Directional disabled assets and underlay composition were fixed and verified (R379/R380).
whole_widget_insensitive.sr104_vue: The historical XtSensitive=False appearance has not been captured.
whole_widget_insensitive.status: GTK2 rendering covered; historical comparison open

range_endpoint.gtk2: R513 confirms that an endpoint stepper is painted from the disabled asset while its input remains blocked; the shared rule calls for the parent palette at a blocked endpoint. R515-R540 explored private custom-engine prototypes, but no role-driven engine was integrated into the product.
range_endpoint.sr104_vue: The matching disabled/endpoint appearance is not established from SR10.4/VUE.
range_endpoint.status: known GTK2 product mismatch; correction/integration and historical basis remain open

thumb_drag.gtk2: Private GTK2 interaction probes exist, but do not provide a direct SR10.4 measurement.
thumb_drag.sr104_vue: No direct historical drag measurement was identified.

current_profile.status: already active for new GTK2 clients; R683 is preview verification and did not install a separate partial recipe

next: Continue only GTK2. Investigate a role-driven endpoint painter in a private prototype, retaining blocked endpoint input and whole-widget disabled styling. Do not integrate the historical-state prototype into the user theme until its product behavior and supported VUE evidence are clear. Keep horizontal/up held capture gated on I517 and preserve manual review as pending.

coverage_estimate.basis: The profile is active and the public adapter route, all-control scene, normal cells, and GTK2 press/release behavior are verified. A confirmed endpoint paint mismatch remains outside the product fix, and several historical states plus manual acceptance remain open. This is technical coverage of I167, not visual fidelity.
